findings.title: Namespaced implementation identities can self-review
findings.reproduction: With implementationAgent and reviewer both set to agent:codex, the gate strips the namespace only from the reviewer. An isolated real-Git fixture with exact ancestry, paths, review bytes, and ordering therefore returned ok true.
findings.requiredResolution: Canonicalize and validate implementation and reviewer identities symmetrically, reject equal canonical identities, and add the namespaced self-review regression.

findings.title: Verification suite counts are inaccurate
findings.reproduction: The candidate record reports 19 UI-gate and 18 taskctl-schema tests, while the independently executed complete suites contain and passed 22 and 27 tests.
findings.requiredResolution: Correct the evidence narrative to identify the complete executed suite counts.
